task: PHASE 7: CHARACTER, LOCOMOTION AND CAMERA QUALITY BAR
acceptance_criteria: STEP 1: Character pipeline audit: real rigged GLBs vs procedural, bone-affecting clips, facial expression support, morph targets, grounding/scaling, foot sliding analysis.
STEP 2: Define visual character bible: recognizable silhouettes, stylized anatomy/proportions, facial forms, material response, foot contact, mobile contrast.
STEP 3: Select high-value production targets: upgrade main player character/hero presentation, create precise artist-facing asset brief for rig hierarchy, skin weights, poses, budgets.
STEP 4: Animation polish: natural weight distribution, foot slide elimination, limb arcs, torso rotation, smooth transitions, grounding without altering physical collision.
STEP 5: Camera quality: Classic, Character Focus, intro, game-over, photo mode framing, rooftop clarity, hazard visibility, landing shake damping.
STEP 6: Scene presentation: character materials and lighting across dark/bright worlds, portrait readability, mobile safe areas.
STEP 7: Safety & performance: GLB loading/fallback, cloned skeleton ownership, AnimationMixer cleanup, shared materials, zero collision corruption.
STEP 8: Verification release gate: full build, character tests, locomotion tests, camera tests, browser tests, before/after evidence.
